caption:
India just became the world's pharmacy at a record scale. Pharmaceutical exports hit an all-time high this year.

India's pharmaceutical exports hit a record $31.1 billion this financial year - more than double what they were just over a decade ago. The US remains the single biggest buyer, taking over $9 billion of that total, nearly a third of everything India ships.

Vaccine exports alone grew over 26% this year, as India's reputation as a reliable low-cost manufacturer keeps compounding. The government's own target: $50 billion in pharma exports by 2030.

This isn't a lucky year. It's the compounding result of decades spent building manufacturing capacity nobody else wanted to build first.

Sources: Ministry of Commerce and Industry, EY-Parthenon/OPPI, IBEF (2026)
